Name: Candies vs. Hypnodeer
Overview:
Definitely the sweetest game you'll have ever played!

'Candies VS Hypnodeer' is about building a kingdom out of candy, in a world made entirely of... candy!

Match-3 game with a fresh twist on the genre. Quality artwork and engaging gameplay combined form the game, together with not-so-bad Hypnodeer characters who make the title more complex.

Grab the game now and start building your own candy empire. 8 different types of buildings, 2 special items and 2 types of Hypnodeer.

Make yourself a pleasure of getting hypnotized in 'Candies VS Hypnodeer' and beat your friends high-scores on-line!
